import sys
import heapq

MOD = 1000000007
INF = 1000000000000000001

def solve():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    K = next(it)
    cnt1 = 0
    cnt2 = 0
    for _ in range(n):
        w = next(it)
        if w == 50:
            cnt1 += 1
        else:
            cnt2 += 1

    # precompute nCr up to 100
    nCr = [[0]*100 for _ in range(100)]
    for i in range(100):
        for j in range(i+1):
            if j == 0 or j == i:
                nCr[i][j] = 1
            else:
                nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i-1][j] + nCr[i-1][j-1]) % MOD

    def f(p, a, b, c, d):
        p = p * nCr[a][b] % MOD
        p = p * nCr[c][d] % MOD
        return p

    # dist and dp arrays: size 200x200x2
    dist = [[[INF]*2 for _ in range(200)] for __ in range(200)]
    dp = [[[0]*2 for _ in range(200)] for __ in range(200)]
    dist[0][0][0] = 0
    dp[0][0][0] = 1

    pq = [(0, 0, 0, 0)]  # (d, x, y, z)
    while pq:
        d, x, y, z = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if d != dist[x][y][z]:
            continue
        if z == 0:  # boat on left, move to right
            remX = cnt1 - x
            remY = cnt2 - y
            for i in range(remX+1):
                for j in range(remY+1):
                    if i+j == 0:
                        continue
                    if i*50 + j*100 > K:
                        break
                    ways = f(dp[x][y][z], remX, i, remY, j)
                    nx = x + i
                    ny = y + j
                    nz = 1
                    if dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1:
                        if dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1:
                            dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = ways
                            heapq.heappush(pq, (dist[nx][ny][nz], nx, ny, nz))
                        else:
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + ways) % MOD
        else:  # boat on right, move to left
            remX = x
            remY = y
            for i in range(remX+1):
                for j in range(remY+1):
                    if i+j == 0:
                        continue
                    if i*50 + j*100 > K:
                        break
                    ways = f(dp[x][y][z], remX, i, remY, j)
                    nx = x - i
                    ny = y - j
                    nz = 0
                    if dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1:
                        if dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1:
                            dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = ways
                            heapq.heappush(pq, (dist[nx][ny][nz], nx, ny, nz))
                        else:
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + ways) % MOD

    if dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] == INF:
        print(-1)
    else:
        print(dist[cnt1][cnt2][1])
    print(dp[cnt1][cnt2][1])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
